--- CRITICAL FINDINGS ---

[RT-1] High-frequency per-client publishes cause fan-out
File: src/controller/NetcodeController.tsx (L1-L200)
Evidence: sendUpdate is invoked every 100ms and triggers two publishData calls (position + animation) using DataPacket_Kind.LOSSY, producing ≈20 publishes/sec per client; each publish is broadcast by LiveKit to all subscribers.  
Impact: Fan-out multiplies with participants (N * ~20 msgs/s), easily saturating server/network or client processing and causing dropped messages and CPU/network exhaustion as concurrency grows.  
Fix: Reduce send frequency, aggregate/coalesce updates (one packet with deltas), add per-client rate limits, or move aggregation/authority server-side to limit fan-out.

[RT-2] No sequence/ replay / reconciliation for state updates
File: src/controller/NetcodeController.tsx (L1-L200)
Evidence: Data sent is plain LOSSY JSON with no sequence numbers, timestamps, ACKs or snapshot/replay logic; reconnects/joining users have no mechanism to fetch authoritative state.  
Impact: Disconnects or packet loss lead to permanently stale or inconsistent position/animation state for clients with no replay, producing visual glitches and state divergence at scale.  
Fix: Add sequence numbers/timestamps and a snapshot/replay or reliable channel for on-join recovery, or maintain authoritative server-side state for reconcilation.

--- WARNING FINDINGS ---

[RT-3] Webhook DB counters lack idempotency
File: src/app/api/webhooks/livekit/route.ts (L1-L200)
Evidence: participant_joined/participant_left handlers increment/decrement room.currentUsers directly on every webhook without deduplication or idempotency checks.  
Impact: Retries or duplicate webhooks under churn can corrupt the currentUsers counter and produce incorrect presence/limits, confusing autoscaling or billing.  
Fix: Persist webhook event IDs or reconcile counts from participant lists (or use transactional upserts) to make updates idempotent.

[RT-4] Room existence check

[RT-4] Room existence check lists all LiveKit rooms
File: src/pages/api/universe/create-room.ts (L1-L200)
Evidence: The handler calls roomService.listRooms() and then scans for the room name before creating it.  
Impact: Frequent room-creation traffic will cause expensive list calls, raising latency and API throttling risk as rooms scale.  
Fix: Use a single getRoom / createRoom with error handling (handle ALREADY_EXISTS), or cache existence state instead of listing all rooms.
